reviewer_statement: Author-source-scientific review of matched FPCA bootstrap numerical estimands, seeded resampling and exactly nine source result fields. Newly added source-boundary cases with full typed frozen Python 1.2 numerical oracle for three seeds, two FPCA dimensions and both resampling modes. Cross-platform exact-head CI pending, no independent scientific certification.
native_language_semantic_policy: Native R class and nested native FPCA representation replace Python dataclass and fitted Python model objects. Source numerical arrays, fields and provenance are matched in explicit mode; unseeded stochastic calls produce independent entropy-dependent draws, not bitwise identical cross-run samples. Native-only fixed index replay is rejected in strict source mode.

case_evidence.description: Frozen Python 1.2 stability.py bootstrap_fpca_component_envelopes with retained FPC count, bootstrap count, curve versus participant resampling unit, optional participant metadata column, scaling, level, random_state and validated TrajectorySet; native R python_boundary_mode selects exact nine-field outer scientific return.

Complete finite one- and two-channel trajectory sets, 12 curves, 19 observed grid times, six repeated-participant groups, independent curve resampling and whole-participant resampling, 1 and 2 retained components, B=2 or 5; NumPy PCG64 seeds 0, 7 and 41.

Both single-channel and multivariate FPCA refits on each resampled training set, exact NumPy PCG64 draw chronology, functional maximum-absolute-component assignment and sign alignment, source NumPy linear pointwise quantiles and signed-similarity absolute values, source reference fitted eigenvalue spectrum.

Reject fewer than two bootstrap replicates, nonpositive or invalid FPC count, unsupported resample unit, missing participant_column, incomplete trajectories, invalid confidence level, invalid Python boundary mode or native-only externally fixed bootstrap draws in strict source mode.

Python FPCAComponentEnvelopeResult canonical ordered outer fields: reference, lower, median, upper, similarities, level, resampling_unit, random_state, provenance. Source provenance has exactly method, n_bootstrap, n_components, scaling, participant_column and coverage_claim; no R-only audit provenance in explicit source mode.

Descriptive pointwise envelopes of reference-aligned bootstrap FPCA loading functions and corresponding component similarities; fixed component dimensionality, not pointwise/simultaneous confidence coverage and no inference about eigenfunction truth.

independent_review_status: Author-reviewed, six source contract domains with digest-pinned tests; no independently certified contracts and exact-head R/Python CI pending.
language_specific_limits: R's nested fitted FPCA reference object and Python's FPCAResult are scientifically corresponding but not the same runtime class or model backend object.
Unseeded random_state=NULL generates nonreplayable samples from each language's available entropy stream; no exact realized sample equality is claimed.
Native R demands retained FPC count strictly below number of curves, whereas Python performs a looser explicit pre-check and may fail later during FPCA fitting near full rank.
R default mode retains its extensive audit provenance and native fixed-index replay; canonical Python outer output requires python_boundary_mode=TRUE.
